_doc: E169 F3: the Nine Dragon Stack teaser's sound design (the game's own sounds come from public/assets/sfx/best/). Every family is generated with MOSS-SoundEffect v2 and Stable Audio 3 Medium (3 seeds each) and sfx_pick.py keeps the better take by CLAP rank (AGENTS.md 'Audio engines'). `desc` is the CLAP ranking text.

nd-rain.desc: heavy rain falling on stone pavement and tin awnings
nd-rain.prompt: Heavy steady rain falling on wet stone paving and drumming on tin awnings and eaves in a narrow city street at night, water dripping and splashing, close and detailed. Continuous field recording, no thunder, no music.

nd-neon.desc: the electric hum and buzz of a neon sign
nd-neon.prompt: The electric hum and buzz of an old neon sign close up: a steady transformer drone with a crackling flicker now and then. Continuous, no rhythm, no music.

nd-walla.desc: a distant crowd murmuring at a night market
nd-walla.prompt: A distant busy night market crowd far away between tall buildings: the indistinct murmur of many people, no clear words, soft footsteps, rain, a big reverberant space. Continuous field recording, no music.

nd-jian-draw.desc: a sword drawn from its scabbard with a metallic ring
nd-jian-draw.prompt: A straight steel sword drawn fast from its scabbard: a bright metallic scrape rising into a clear, shimmering ring of the blade. Close, clean, cinematic, no music.

nd-jian-swish.desc: a fast sword slash whooshing through the air
nd-jian-swish.prompt: A thin steel sword slashed very fast through the air: a sharp high whoosh with a crisp electric sizzle at the end. Close, clean, cinematic, no music.

nd-grapple-fire.desc: a grappling hook launcher firing a cable
nd-grapple-fire.prompt: A wrist grappling hook launcher firing: a sharp pneumatic thump and a metallic clack, then a thin cable whizzing out fast. Close, cinematic, no music.

nd-line-whip.desc: a steel cable whipping and twanging
nd-line-whip.prompt: A thin taut steel cable whipping through the air and snapping tight: a high whistling whip crack and a vibrating metallic twang. Close, no music.

nd-claw-bite.desc: a metal claw clanking shut on an iron ring
nd-claw-bite.prompt: A heavy brass grappling claw slamming shut onto an iron ring: a hard metallic clank and bite with a short ringing resonance. Close, cinematic, no music.

nd-zip.desc: zipping fast along a cable with a whirring reel and rushing wind
nd-zip.prompt: Zipping fast along a steel cable: the rising mechanical whir of a spinning reel and a rushing wind whoosh that builds and passes by. Cinematic, no music.

nd-gong-hit.desc: a huge taiko and gong impact hit
nd-gong-hit.prompt: A huge cinematic trailer impact: a deep taiko drum boom layered with a large Chinese gong crash and a sub-bass drop, decaying into a long dark reverberant tail. Trailer sound design.

nd-reverse-gong.desc: a reversed gong swell rising into a hit
nd-reverse-gong.prompt: A reversed gong swell: a large Chinese gong played backwards, rising louder over two seconds and cutting off sharply. Cinematic trailer transition, nothing else.

nd-rise.desc: a rising rush of wind climbing upward
nd-rise.prompt: A rising cinematic whoosh of air rushing upward, climbing steadily in pitch for three seconds like flying straight up a tall shaft, cutting off at its peak. Trailer sound design, no melody.
